product.inspiration: แต่งบ้านกับ เหมี่ยว reel 1.8M views (garden swing) — format only: real-looking demo in the yard, short

host.role: the main character: this exact Thai katoey woman (same face, long wavy dark-brown hair, pink satin shirt, white shorts)

chair.role: the product: this exact cream macrame hanging chair - a round 80 cm steel ring seat woven from thick soft cream cotton rope in a diamond net pattern, long tassel fringe hanging under the seat, four ropes rising to one top ring. Keep its shape, colour and size exactly

before.role: the place BEFORE: this exact backyard corner of an old Thai wooden house (same house wall, big tree, ground, camera angle), bare and dull

after.role: the place AFTER: the same backyard corner made cosy with the cream macrame hanging chair hanging from the tree branch

yard-before.prompt: Photoreal vertical 9:16 smartphone photo, soft afternoon daylight. The backyard corner of an old Thai wooden house in the countryside: weathered brown wooden wall and a raised wooden porch edge on the left, a big shady mango tree with one thick low horizontal branch about 2.2 m high in the middle, bare dusty dirt ground with a few dry leaves, an old faded plastic chair and a bucket, dull and empty. Nobody in frame, no text.

yard-after.prompt: The exact same backyard corner, same camera angle, same wooden house wall, same mango tree and branch, but made into a cosy cafe-like corner: the cream macrame hanging chair from the product image hangs from the thick tree branch by its ropes, a soft white cushion and a small throw inside the seat, warm string fairy lights draped along the branch and the porch edge, a small woven rug and two potted plants on swept clean ground, the old plastic chair and bucket gone, warm golden late-afternoon light. Nobody in frame, no text.

beats.vo: ตายแล้วแม่! มุมหลังบ้านโล่งๆ ตรงนี้ วันนี้พี่จะเปลี่ยนเป็นมุมคาเฟ่ ด้วยเงินแค่สามร้อยกว่าบาท!

shots.frame: Medium shot (waist up), the katoey woman faces the camera, her face large, sharp and clearly lit. She stands in the dull backyard corner beside the big mango tree, one hand on her chest, mouth open in a shocked gasp, pointing at the empty bare ground.
shots.motion: She gasps and points around the empty corner. Static camera, no zoom.

shots.frame: Wide shot of the dull empty backyard corner: bare dusty ground, old plastic chair and bucket under the big mango tree. Nobody in frame.
shots.motion: Leaves sway slightly in the breeze. Static camera. No people.

shots.frame: Close-up of hands with pink satin sleeves stroking the thick soft cream cotton rope weave and the long tassel fringe of the macrame hanging chair, soft daylight. The chair is exactly the product: round 80 cm ring seat of thick cream cotton rope net with a long tassel fringe.

shots.motion: The empty chair sways gently on its ropes. Static camera. No people.
